name: Icon
description: Sizes any icon onto the glyph ladder and gives it one ink.

size.description: A step on the glyph ladder: xs 12, sm 14, md 16, lg 18, xl 24

weight.description: The glyph weight, forwarded to icon components that take one

tone.description: The glyph ink: secondary and tertiary follow the text ladder, accent is the accent ink, the status inks mark real state only. Omit to inherit currentColor

when: A symbol sits beside text, inside a button, or leads a list item
guidelines: Reserve the success, warning, and danger tones for real state
Use the bold weight beside strong text and fill for a filled state; regular everywhere else
Nothing above 24: a bigger glyph is an illustration, not an icon
accessibility: Icons ship aria-hidden — they are decoration until you label them
aria-label (or aria-labelledby) labels a meaningful icon: it renders role="img" and is no longer hidden
An icon-only button needs VisuallyHidden text
Color alone never carries the message

examples.name: Default
examples.description: Inherits the size and color of its surroundings.

examples.name: Sizes
examples.description: Steps tuned to the type scale, so icons never float off the baseline.

examples.name: Tones
examples.description: One ink axis: the quiet text inks for glyphs beside secondary copy, the status inks for real state.

examples.name: Weights
examples.description: Regular by default; bold beside strong text; fill for a filled state.

relations.note: Use inside icon-only buttons with VisuallyHidden label
Pair with VisuallyHidden for accessible icon-only elements
Can be used as badge icon prop

propsSummary: size: xs|sm|md|lg|xl - a step on the 12/14/16/18/24 glyph ladder
tone: secondary|tertiary|accent|info|success|warning|danger - one ink axis; omit to inherit currentColor
